description: A FIRST-position `given n :>` arm fires in an EXPRESSION-position match — a call argument, `@v = match …` and `x = match …` — exactly as in `const d = match` (S462 review M1). A later `given` arm, and a match inside a lambda, are not reached (filed: the single-reader redesign).
rationale: §42.2.3 "In match arms": a `given` arm is a match arm in every position. The expression parser carried these matches as raw arm text that nothing read as a `given` arm, so the arm was dropped and the next arm won.
